definition.def: If something affects a person or thing, it influences them or causes them to change in some way.
examples: Nicotine adversely affects the functioning of the heart and arteries. [VERB noun]
More than seven million people have been affected by drought. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If a disease affects someone, it causes them to become ill.
examples: Arthritis is a crippling disease which affects people all over the world. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If something or someone affects you, they make you feel a strong emotion, especially sadness or pity.
examples: Her experience of the last few hours has deeply affected her. [VERB noun]
Gregor loved his sister, and her loss clearly still affects him. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you affect a particular characteristic or way of behaving, you pretend that it is genuine, or natural for you. [literary]
examples: He listened to them, affecting an amused interest. [VERB noun]
Ms. Redgrave affects a heavy Italian accent. [VERB noun]
